answer: Resist Sybils with endorsement-graph distance: a new identity gains full rights only when its endorsers sit at least three hops apart in the endorsement graph and no cluster of newcomers shares sponsors. Like a comet tracing a lone arc rather than a timber raft lashed together, each identity must forge separate, distant ties, and shale-thin clusters are capped at one new member per epoch. An attacker must therefore cultivate many genuinely unrelated sponsors, paying time and reputation for each fake, while clustered copies are throttled before they can vote or earn.
